TEXT: [FI] And so...
[FI] I graduated from middle school,
[FI] became a high school student,
[FI] then graduated from high school...
[FI] ...and became an university student.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] ...and like that, Kyousuke was being super-annoying.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] Isn't it seriously unbelievable? This time I'm really 
fed up with him.

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT: [FI] ...I see, then will you break up with him?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Muh.

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT:
[FI] If he gets dumped by his beloved girlfriend... that 
will end up as a chance for me.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Y-You're still aiming for him?!

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT: [FI] Oh my, didn't I say it before?

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT: [FI] I will continue fighting you eternally into the future.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] No, just get a boyfriend of your own already!

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT: [FI] I refuse.

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT:
[FI] In the first place... do you think that someone that 
has trouble just making a single friend can get a 
lover?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Don't say it with such self-confidence!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] Ah, geez... maybe I chose the wrong person to 
consult about love with.

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT:
[FI] ...What are you saying, fool? What you're doing isn't 
a love consultation, it's the grumbles of a lover's 
quarrel.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] ...Urgh.

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT:
[FI] If you were seriously fed up with him... I wouldn't 
be in this kind of mood now.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] That's true.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] If he did something horrible to me, you would 
definitely be angry.

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT: [FI] Isn't that obvious?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] Now that I think about it, isn't it strange? You 
yourself are getting in the way of the guy you're 
aiming for, ending up single, aren't you?

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT: [FI] It's just as you say. It truly is troubling.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] ...You're not denying it?

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT:
[FI] If someone I like is going to make a mistake, I have 
to do something, don't I?

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT:
[FI] If our positions were reversed, I'm sure you'd do 
the same thing.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Yes, yes, maybe so.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Yes!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Kirino♪

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] ...Geh.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Geez, Kirino, what's with that "Geh"?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Ah, no, that is, you know.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] W-Why are you here Ayase... so unexpectedly?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] I came here due to some work close by. I wanted 
to see your face.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] You see me every day.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] That's true, but...
[FI] This is bad. What's bad, you ask...

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT:
[FI] What's wrong, Kirino? If we have a visitor, I'll get 
the tea...

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT: [FI] Oh my.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Hello.

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT: [FI] What did you come here for?
[FI] ......Why can't these two get along?
[FI] They've always been like this since they first met.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] I came to see Kirino's face today.

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT:
[FI] I see. Well then, you've already finished your 
business here.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] No, actually, I brought a present with me...
[FI] Well, I'm happy, but...
[FI] She'll definitely quarrel with Kuroneko.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Wow, cakes.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Hehe, actually, I got this from Onee-san.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] Seriously? I super-love the cakes the Tamuras 
make.
[FI] Don't look at me while sighing!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Really? But, aren't I intruding?

[FI] I want to follow the example of this feigned 
ignorance of hers.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Not at all.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Thank you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Umm, just grab a seat somewhere.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Ah, shall I help?

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT: [FI] I'll do it. "Dear guest", please do sit down.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] ...Muh.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] Your words seem to have a hidden meaning 
somehow.

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT: [FI] Did it sound that way? My sincere apologies.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] Aah, I'm jealous of Kuroneko-san for 
being able to live together with Kirino, 
even if it's only for a [font_size=28]limited time.[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] You seem to have some spare rooms, so maybe I 
should also move in here.

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT: [FI] ...W-What?

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT: [FI] D-Don't joke like that. Please stop it.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] Eh, but didn't you recently tell me "Let's get 
along"?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Don't tell me, that was a lie?

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT: [FI] Of course that was a lie. I said it sarcastically.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] ...I never thought you'd respond like that.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Kirino~, Kuroneko-san is bullying me!
[FI] Ayase clutched onto me.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Yes, yes, geez.

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT: [FI] I can't believe you two are the same age.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] ...Hahaha. So anyway, please take care of the tea.

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT: [FI] I intended to do so from the beginning.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Ooh~, looks like someone else has come.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [FI] What's up?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Please pardon us.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Oh, you two, welcome.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] Kirino... your response is completely different from 
when I came.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] There's no way that could be.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] We've brought a present. It's a trivial thing, though...

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [FI] It's not trivial, since I'm the one that chose it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Wow, warabi-mochi from the Tamura Shop.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [FI] Kirino, you like them, right? Ehehe, I remembered.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Thank you, Kanako, Saori.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] I'm glad that you're happy with them.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] Since Ayase is here too, shall we all eat them 
together?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Yes.
